improvement_relation.basis: The compact projection now joins the current Environment binding snapshot to bounded invocation outcomes and exact source event references. It distinguishes substrate availability from verified provider behavior and marks agent-facing discoverability not measured. Focused tests and an authenticated live campaign_state read verified the path; external tool usage and longer-term effectiveness remain unmeasured.
not_measured: whether the join has improved capability discovery across agents or models
whether absent Environment invocation records indicate use through other interfaces
cross-session recurrence or long-term reduction in environmental friction
whether capabilities were used through direct external interfaces
long-term effectiveness after subsequent independent sessions

outcome.analysis_limit: This establishes an inspectable availability-to-recorded-use path for the current Environment session. It does not measure agent discovery, external interface usage, provider correctness, or long-term effectiveness.
outcome.implementation_change: The existing Environmental Capability Intelligence projection now exposes a bounded capability binding and use view in compact responses, retaining availability and invocation source event references.
outcome.verified_capability: An authenticated campaign_state read surfaced nine Environment bindings as substrate-available, preserved no Environment invocation record across the complete selected event history, and explicitly reported agent-facing discoverability as not-measured.
